name: Unidentified Venator-class Star Destroyer
description: A nearly-entirely intact Venator-class Star Destroyer was left abandoned on Level 201 of Coruscant. During the aerial assault on Coruscant between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the Rebel Alliance YT-1300 light freighter Millennium Falcon raced by it as it flew through the level in order to lose TIE/ln space superiority starfighters that were chasing it.
